title: Death of Renee Good: How AI was used to falsely identify the ICE agent who shot her
summary: In the aftermath of Renee Good's death during an immigration raid in Minnesota, an internet manhunt began to identify the ICE agent. Using artificial intelligence, internet users 'unmasked' the officer at the scene and falsely identified him, triggering threats and vitriol towards 2 unrelated people with that name. Vedika Bahl explains in Truth or Fake.
